THE MOTIVATION
AS THE ONSEN  GROUP  PROGRESSES  , THE DESIGN  OF THE NEW  BRANCH  MUST  REFLECT  THE MATURITY  AND  
CONFIDENCE  OF A COMPANY  WITH  LONG -TERM  VISION . THE SPACE  SHOULD  BE CONCEIVED  NOT  ONLY  AS A 
WELLNESS  FACILITY  BUT  AS A BRAND  FLAGSHIP —EMBODYING  THE GROUP’S  EXPERTISE  IN ONSEN  CULTURE,  
OPERATIONAL  EXCELLENCE,  AND  COMMITMENT  TO INNOVATION . PARTICULAR  ATTENTION  WILL  BE PLACED  
ON ARTICULATING  A REFINED,  SERVICE -ORIENTED  ATMOSPHERE  THAT  CAN  ACCOMMODATE  EVOLVING  
SERVICE  MODELS,  NEW  CUSTOMER  JOURNEYS,  AND  FUTURE  OPERATIONAL  SCALABILITY .DESIGN EXPLORATORY

THE FUTURE SPA AND WELLNESS

## Page 44

The 'Wellness Economy' is Set to Become a New Global Powerhouse Worth 
$7.9 Trillion
“The trend reflects a major consumer shift from reactive treatment to proactive prevention”
To millennials and Gen Zers,wellness has become a daily, personalized practice rather than a set 
of occasional activities or purchases.Wellness Tourism is another key driver , expected to become a trillion -dollar sector and offering 
opportunities for countries like Thailand to leverage their "Wellness Soft Power."
Reference: Global Wellness Institute (2025). Global Wellness Economy Monitor 2025. Miami, FL: GWI.        
McKinsey & Company – Listen to the article: The $2 trillion global wellness market gets a millennial and Gen Z

## Page 45

INTERIOR DESIGN PRESENTATION PD1 17 JUL 2025SOCIAL
Historically, alcohol consumption has often been a centerpiece 
of social gatherings . But today, alternative activities like 
wellness retreats, sober -friendly events and even dry bars are 
becoming increasingly popular.
Many younger people are redefining what it means to have 
funwithout the need for alcohol . For younger generations, 
meaningful social experiences are less about following 
traditional scripts and more about creating inclusive and 
intentional environments.

## Page 46

Spas will become centers of longevity 
and life extension
A fusion of next generation wellness and 
health informatics is going to create a 
new era for spas. The information to 
which we will have access will allow spas 
to design personalized programs for 
enhancement and prevention.
Spas may even become human design 
clinics
At the ultimate degree of this, spa, 
longevity, and health enhancement 
merge into human design clinics. Canton 
called this “Human 2.0” and describes it 
this way:
A NEW ERA OF COMMUNAL WELLNESS
